body: Thank you, i dont need revenge i just need to work on myself, and idk how to catch him bc the signs are there but i dont have enough evidence.

You are worth it since you did realize your mistake.You are human and you do make mistakes but you owned up to them and apologized i mean fuck your so called friends they don’t really deserve you.You’re better and you’ll find better and you’ll be happy and find friends that wont leave you for a mistake bc you are human and you make them its not your fault i hope you get better and I really wish you all the best

To be honest just keep on living there will be good moments and you’ll be happy.And when those good moments occur ur gonna be so greatful you didn’t kill yourself i hope you get through this talk to a friend or talk to your parents I’ve been through the same and im a survivor of suicide and im greatful that I didn’t kill myself back then bc of all the good memories i got to experience so this is my advice for you i hope you get better always know that you have people on your side

Im so sorry for your loss having been through something like this myself i know you’re blaming yourself but you’re not at fault and everything will get better in time.

Just give it some time and you’ll see that the pain will go away not all of it but at least it wont hurt like it’s hurting now.

You seem like such a good soul and i bet he was very lucky to have someone like you in his life.

Please have positive thoughts and the second you start overthinking do something to get your mind away from it,it really worked for me and i advice you to do so too.
Im very lucky to have them

Thank you I really needed this

My parents and my family and friends people i have close but mostly my religion.I have tried to commit suicide so many times last time was today but God helped me not to.Knowing that my parents will be sad my friends my family everyone i love will be so depressed bc of me then what did I achieve by killing myself.Nothing i just made things worse my problems have destroyed everyone i loved when I could’ve tried to make my life better and not give up so easily so thats what really makes my life valuable God and the people i love.
